newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Elec & Eltek gives share placement detail.
newsitem.headline: Elec & Eltek gives share placement detail.

text.p: Elec & Eltek International Co Ltd (E&EI) said on Tuesday 14 million of its shares were being placed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong by its parent company Elec & Eltek International Holdings Ltd (E&EIH).
E&EI said in a statement the shares represented 13.59 percent of its capital.
The placement shares were being offered at US$5.30, a 7.83 percent discount on their listed price in Singapore, which stood at US$5.75 at the close of trade on May 9.
E&EIH's shareholding in E&EI would be reduced to 51.8 percent from 65.39 percent after the placement and proceeds from the deal would be added to E&EIH's general working capital, the statement said.
